text:
maya: FYI onboarding RedBay LoRA is in staging. Pushing quick eval pack — synthetic prompt set + invoice examples. thread for quick triage.
joel: Link to pack? I'll run on int8 and fp16.
maya: uploaded to s3: s3://redwood-onboard/redbay/synthetic-pack-v1.jsonl — includes 250 prompts (invoices, q&a, multi-turn).
priya: running smoke with `rwi eval run --model raven-7b-4bit --quant int8 --cases 250` now. ETA ~12m
deploy-bot: Eval job 9876 queued on dedicated-gpu-pool-a
tony: Heads up: we saw tokenization mismatch with RedBay's tokenizer override in their adapter. Might need remap.
eva: Can you paste the mismatch snippet?
tony: From sample id 71: input '£1,200' -> tokens [ 'â', '£', '1', ',', '200' ] vs expected ['£','1',',','200']
priya: ah ok. I'll add normalizer step in pack: `.normalize_currency=True`
maya: Also need embed fallback: if LoRA reduces embed norm > 0.3 fallback to base model for embedding route. Customer cares about similarity recall.
joel: :thumbsup: implementable via router policy `fallback_on_embed_delta`
priya: small status: int8 generation PPL increases ~0.6 on invoice field, but top-1 match accuracy stable. sending logs.
maya: Attach logs pls.
priya: ```
job 9876 summary:
- gen p50 latency 180ms -> 220ms (int8)
- embed cosine drop mean 0.28
- accuracy (invoice ID exact) 98/100
- hallucination flag 2 cases (dates)
```
maya: Couple asks from customer: 1) keep canonical token mapping in adapter spec 2) drop suffix logits cache for invoice route 3) run small blind A/B with `raven-7b-fp16` vs `raven-lora-7b-int8`
eva: I can schedule A/B on dedicated for 2h window tonight.
joel: If we need to tweak quant kernels, bring to eng-runtime — might be a perf issue not correctness.
priya: I'll patch pack with token normalizer + embed fallback + instructions for A/B, new pack v1.1 at s3 (s3://redwood-onboard/redbay/synthetic-pack-v1.1.jsonl).
maya: Thanks. Please ping when A/B results are in. If regressions >1% or embed drop >0.35 we rollback.
priya: noted. ping @tony @eva when job 9880 starts.
deploy-bot: A/B job 9880 started on dedicated-gpu-pool-b
eva: Baseline -> 7b-fp16; Variant -> lora-int8. Running 250 paired queries. ETA 18m.
priya: Quick note: add small parse rule for dates to reduce hallucinations.
maya: :thumbsup: let's keep thread for final decision.
